trial_court: Court of Dr. Neera Bharihoke, District Judge (Commercial Court)-06
case_name: M/S Sage Technologies Pvt. Ltd vs M/S Shree Baidyanath Ayurved Bhawan

parties.respondent_defendant: M/S Shree Baidyanath Ayurved Bhawan Private Limited & Ors.

facts_of_case: The Plaintiff filed a suit for recovery of Rs.59,50,010/- alongwith interest against the Defendants.

legal_principles.principle: A successful Go-Live requires meticulous planning, careful execution, and effective communication to ensure a seamless transition to the new system.
legal_principles.held: However, the Plaintiff, instead of admitting and correcting their wrongs, was only adamant and stuck on the remaining payment for UAT.
cited_cases: M/S Sage Technologies Pvt. Ltd vs M/S Shree Baidyanath Ayurved Bhawan ... (2025)

legal_principles.principle: Adequate support should be available to end-users to address any issues or questions they may have after the system has gone live.
legal_principles.held: Regular maintenance and updates should also be carried out to ensure the system's optimal performance.
cited_cases: M/S Sage Technologies Pvt. Ltd vs M/S Shree Baidyanath Ayurved Bhawan ... (2025)

outcome.final_order: The final court order was in favor of the Plaintiff and directed the Defendant to pay the amount claimed with interest.
